 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb3357d82d155fa23e0466cbb0e2b696e989c8783ed92f1820a2ab54a5d79ccd.png]

ABC, AEC, GEF, GHF, IHL, IJL - 6

ABE, BEC, IHJ, HLJ - 4

GCL, AFI - 2

ACG, GIL - 2

GCF, GLF, AGF, GIF, ACF, FIL- 6

Total number of triangles = 12 + 6 + 4 + 2 + 2 + 6 = 32

Hence, the figure has total 32 triangles.
